# UniLimit

> Python 3.11+ rate limiting for FastAPI, Starlette, Django, DRF, and plain Python.
> Use the native integrations for new code. Compatibility adapters for SlowAPI and
> django-ratelimit cover their main APIs and reject options they cannot honour.

## Start here

- [Runnable quickstart](README.md): install, run, and observe an HTTP 429.
- [Documentation index](docs/README.md): choose your framework.
- [API reference](API_DESIGN.md): authoritative public API.
- [Extended assistant context](llms-full.txt): semantics and a working example.
- [Deployment](docs/deployment.md): workers, identities, outages, and shutdown.
- [Migration](docs/migration.md): adapter guides for
  [SlowAPI](docs/fastapi/migrating-from-slowapi.md) and
  [django-ratelimit](docs/django/migrating-from-django-ratelimit.md), with differences.

## Rules for generated code

- Core memory usage: `pip install unilimit`.
- Redis-backed FastAPI: `pip install "unilimit[fastapi,redis]"`; add an ASGI server separately.
- Starlette without FastAPI: `"unilimit[starlette]"` and `unilimit.integrations.starlette`.
- Redis-backed Django / DRF: `"unilimit[django,redis]"` / `"unilimit[drf,redis]"`.
- A positional string in `RateLimit` or `ratelimit` is a rule name; inline rates use `rate=`.
- FastAPI: call `setup(app, limiter)` for middleware and shutdown. Pass authentication
  results through an identity dependency; do not assume FastAPI sets `request.user`.
- DRF: configure `UNILIMIT` and `DEFAULT_THROTTLE_RATES`; throttles run after authentication.
- Atomic batches cover memory, standalone Redis, and a single Cluster slot. Cross-slot
  batches can partially consume. Middleware and endpoint stages remain separate batches.
- Memory and optional outage fallback are per process. Default backend failure mode is open.
- Identity digests are BLAKE2b-128, keyed only when `identity_secret` is configured.
- Never put raw identities in rule names, logs, or metric labels.
- Do not promise drop-in compatibility, exact sliding-window logs, or superior performance.
